name: AABB Clamping
definition: Fast approximation of history rectification using an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) constructed from min/max color values of neighboring pixels per channel.
summary: AABB Clamping is a fast history rectification technique that prevents ghosting by clamping historical colors to per-channel min-max bounds, distinguishing itself through computational efficiency over more accurate convex hull methods.
